# SNIFFLES2

Call structural variants from aligned long reads with Sniffles2. The process removes VCF records containing `.:0:0:0:NULL` after calling.

When `input_exclude_flags` is nonzero, samtools writes and indexes a BAM without reads matching those flags before Sniffles runs. Zero uses the original BAM.

Inputs: `alignment` record with `id` (String), `bam` (Path to indexed BAM), `bai` (Path to its index), `ref` (Path to matching FASTA), and `fai` (Path to its index); `minsvlen` (Integer, minimum SV length), `cluster_merge_pos` (Integer, cluster merge distance), and `input_exclude_flags` (Integer, excluded BAM flags). Supply the three numeric options explicitly. Use an ID suitable for a filename.

Output: record with the same `id` and filtered `vcf` (`<id>.calls.vcf`).

nextflow.enable.types = true

record Alignment {
    id: String
    bam: Path
    bai: Path
    ref: Path
    fai: Path
}

process SNIFFLES2 {
    container 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/sniffles_samtools:12d44c9566588b38'
    cpus 2

    input:
    alignment: Alignment
    minsvlen: Integer
    cluster_merge_pos: Integer
    input_exclude_flags: Integer

    output:
    record(id: alignment.id, vcf: file("${alignment.id}.calls.vcf"))

    script:
    def input_bam = input_exclude_flags == 0 ? "${alignment.bam}" : "${alignment.id}.filtered.bam"
    def filter_bam = input_exclude_flags == 0 ? '' : """
    samtools view -b -F ${input_exclude_flags} -o ${input_bam} ${alignment.bam}
    samtools index ${input_bam}
    """
    """
    ${filter_bam}
    sniffles \
        --threads ${task.cpus} \
        --sample-id ${alignment.id} \
        --minsvlen ${minsvlen} \
        --cluster-merge-pos ${cluster_merge_pos} \
        --input ${input_bam} \
        --reference ${alignment.ref} \
        --vcf ${alignment.id}.sniffles.vcf
    sed '/.:0:0:0:NULL/d' ${alignment.id}.sniffles.vcf > ${alignment.id}.calls.vcf
    """
}

$schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextflow-io/schemas/refs/heads/main/module/v1/schema.json
name: seqera-services/sniffles2
version: 0.1.0
kind: Process
description: Call structural variants from long-read alignments and remove null-genotype records.
keywords:
- structural variants
- long reads
- vcf
license: MIT
authors:
- Seqera Services
tools:
- sniffles:
    description: Structural variant caller for long reads.
    documentation: https://github.com/fritzsedlazeck/Sniffles
- samtools:
    description: Remove alignments with excluded BAM flags before calling.
    documentation: http://www.htslib.org/doc/samtools.html
input:
- name: alignment
  type: record
  description: Record with id (String), bam, bai, ref, and fai (Paths).
- name: minsvlen
  type: integer
  description: Minimum SV length passed to --minsvlen.
- name: cluster_merge_pos
  type: integer
  description: Cluster merge distance passed to --cluster-merge-pos.
- name: input_exclude_flags
  type: integer
  description: BAM flags excluded with samtools before calling; zero uses the original BAM.
output:
- - name: id
    type: string
    description: Input ID.
  - name: vcf
    type: file
    description: Sniffles VCF after removal of null-genotype records.
